== Summary ==
The main event hall at the start of Game 2, Hyatt Regency by Mall of America, Bloomington, Minnesota. 58 players took part., at the [[2026 World Championship]] (Hyatt Regency Bloomington by Mall of America, Bloomington, Minnesota).
